metaphor: A row of equally long planks (multiples of 19) with one plank shorter than the row end.

metaphor: A strip of consecutive integers with the perfect squares punched out like windows.

must_not_appear: Adding percentages of different wholes as if one base

metaphor: Identical buckets lined up, each holding the same amount, total poured evenly.
